name: THORChain DEX
rootCause: One of THORChain’s Asgard vaults was compromised, with the attacker draining funds simultaneously across multiple supported chains (at least nine), resulting in losses of approximately $10-11 million+ (including ~36.75 BTC worth ~$3M and ~$7M+ in EVM tokens). The protocol halted trading and signing after automatic detection of abnormal behavior. User funds and LP positions were safe; only protocol-owned funds were affected. THORChain disclosed that a newly churned validator drained approximately $10.7 million from a single Asgard vault on May 15, 2026 after exploiting a vulnerability in the network's GG20 threshold-signature infrastructure. Public technical analysis attributed the incident to missing Paillier proof validation that allegedly allowed gradual leakage of signing-share material during repeated ceremonies until the vault key could be reconstructed offline. THORChain publicly confirmed that the incident involved a vulnerability in its GG20 Threshold Signature Scheme implementation, but stated that the investigation remained ongoing and withheld detailed technical specifics.…
